  [Life Sciences]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Life Sciences overview][188]
  **Real-World Data**
  [NLP-Enriched EHR Data Solutions][189] Large-scale, high-quality health data sets.
  **Real-World Evidence**
  [Real-World Evidence][190] Retrospective and prospective research by RWE experts.
  [Real-World Evidence Analytics Platform][191] SaaS application enabling efficient analysis of
  real-world data.
  **Point of Care Marketing**
  [Digital Health Media][192] Highly targeted brand awareness messaging in the EHR.*
* [Health Plans + Payers][193]
  [Health Plan Payers]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Health Plans + Payers overview][194]
  **Gap Closure**
  [Gap Closure Services][195] Proactive, clinically-driven services to help health plans and their
  network providers close care gaps.
  [Care Gap Alerting][196] Point-of-care care gap alerting.
  [Provider Engagement Solutions][197] Streamlined payer-provider collaboration for better gap
  closure.
  **Risk Adjustment**
  [Health Equity Analytics][198] Go beyond Social Determinants of Health (SDoH).
  [Risk Adjustment Analytics][199] Analytics to find and prioritize gaps and opportunities.
  [Risk Mitigator][200] RADV audits - be prepared, not scared.
  [Comprehensive Submissions][201] One cloud-based data management platform for all government
  programs.
  [Utilization Analytics][202] Delivers visibility needed to monitor and manage key performance
  indicators.
  **Data Exchange + Coding**
  [eChart Courier][203] Automated electronic chart retrieval.
  [eChart Coder][204] Boost productivity and reduce costs with Veradigm eChart Coder.
  [eChart Integration and Analytics][205] Automated exchange of clinical data and medical record
  information for analysis.
  **Quality Management**
  [Quality Analytics][206] Proven analytic solution to help plans enhance Quality performance across
  their member base.
  [Risk Adjustment and Quality Management][207] Real-time visibility to monitor and manage your KPIs
  for risk and quality alike.
  **Clearinghouse + EDI**
  [Veradigm Payerpath][208] Claims and risk adjustment solution including an effective collaboration
  delivering streamlined EDI.
* [Healthcare Providers][209]
  [Healthcare Provider]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Healthcare Providers overview][210]
  **Our Platform**
  [Veradigm Suite][211] Explore Veradigm’s powerful healthcare solutions designed to streamline
  operations, improve patient care, and boost practice efficiency.
  **Streamline Practice Operations**
  [Practice Management][212] Simplified software for effortless scheduling, billing, and claims
  processing.
  [AI Patient Scheduling][213] Automate and optimize patient scheduling with artificial
  intelligence.
  **Improve Clinical Efficiency**
  [EHR Software][214] Adaptable ambulatory EHR platform that supports your clinical documentation
  and workflow needs.
  [ePrescribe][215] Affordable and certified e-Prescribing solution including controlled substances.
  [Gap Closure Alerting][216] Point-of-care care gap alerting.
  [Clinical Data Registries][217] Registry participation for providers.
  [eChart Courier][218] Save time, reduce costs, and increase efficiency by automating medical chart
  retrieval.
  **Maximize Revenue**
  [Revenue Cycle Services][219] Let us handle billing, minimize denials, enhance coding, and ensure
  timely payments.
  [Coding Services][220] Get help to reduce staff burden and increase revenue - let our team manage
  coding for you.
  [Veradigm Payerpath][221] All-in-one revenue cycle management solution that features a top-tier
  clearinghouse.
  [Veradigm Intelligent Payments][222] Simplify patient billing and boost collections with
  intelligent, automated payments.
  **Engage Patients**
  [Patient Engagement Platform][223] Integrate with a mobile-first patient engagement platform.
  **Optimize Resources and Spend**
  [ERP Fiscal Management][224] Automate finance workflows and improve visibility into spend,
  reporting, and compliance.
  [ERP Point of Use][225] Track supply usage in clinical settings to reduce waste and improve
  accuracy.
  [ERP Supply Chain][226] Streamline purchasing and inventory with real-time visibility from
  requisition to delivery.
* [Health IT Vendors][227]
  [Veradigm Network]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Healthcare IT Vendor Solutions overview][228]
  **Powered by the Network**
  [Life Sciences][229] Empowering life science with trusted data and insights from the point of
  care.
  [Health Plans + Payers][230] Connecting payers to the Veradigm Network’s comprehensive, national
  provider footprint.
  [Providers][231] Integrated clinical & financial solutions for a healthier practice.
  **API Connectivity**
  [Veradigm Connect][232] Connect the latest health tech solutions with the physicians and patients
  who need them.
  [App Expo][233] Become one of hundreds of certified applications and devices for provider
  practices built on open APIs.
  [Diagnostic Ordering and Results Network (DORN)][234] Connecting EHR Vendors with Lab and
  Radiology centers.
  **Electronic Prescribing**
  [Veradigm ePrescribe Enterprise][235] Integrated, advanced, easy-to-use ePrescribing for EHR and
  HIT vendors.
* [Insights][236]
  [Two hands typing on a laptop]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Filter through all of Veradigm's Insights][237]
  **Veradigm Insights**
  [Blog Posts][238] Read through our collection of valuable insights.
  [Videos][239] Watch our videos to learn more about our offerings.
  [Thought Leadership][240] Read the latest healthcare insights from our team of subject matter
  experts.
  [Podcasts][241] Listen to our podcasts to hear healthcare insights from our team of experts.
  [Webinars][242] Watch our webinars to learn more about how we are transforming health,
  insightfully.
  **Resources**
  [RWE Publications][243] Read through our RWE publications and learn how we help clients.
  [Clinical Data Registries][244] Explore our registry publications and learn how we help clients.
  [*Smart Medicine* Podcast][245] Thought-provoking podcast dedicated to understanding the
  intersection of care and innovation
  **Trending Topics**
  [Value-Based Care][246] Comprehensive guide to value-based care, including use cases, relevant
  blog articles, white papers and more.
  [Real-World Evidence][247] Complete overview of real-world evidence, why it’s important, and how
  it’s used in healthcare.
  [Real-World Data][248] Thorough review of what real-world healthcare data is, how it’s collected,
  and how it’s used across the healthcare spectrum.
  [Payer Provider Relationships Guide][249] Discover the impact of payer-provider relationships on
  healthcare. Learn how collaboration improves patient care and addresses challenges.

# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

## In the news

Read the latest press releases and media mentions.
[ Explore newsroom ][92]

## Insights

Access the newest in thought leadership.
[ Explore insights ][93]

# Careers with purpose

With a global presence and 44,000+ team members strong, AmerisourceBergen is committed to making a
difference in the future of health.
[ Explore careers ][94]

# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

## In the news

[ Explore newsroom ][92]

[ Explore insights ][93]

# Careers with purpose

With a global presence and 44,000+ team members strong, AmerisourceBergen is committed to making a
difference in the future of health.
[ Explore careers ][94]

## Healthcare Professionals

Committed to helping you enhance your practice and the experience of your patients through connected
devices and digitalised data sharing.

[Healthcare Professionals][9]
* [ Primary Care ][10]
  
  Supporting every aspect of your clinical practice, including physical exam, diagnostic cardiology,
  vitals monitoring and vision screening
* [ Hospital Care ][11]
  
  Advancing products and technologies designed to speed patient recovery and streamline clinical
  workflows
* [ Surgical Care ][12]
  
  Delivering innovations that enable reduced operating times, faster patient recovery and improved
  outcomes
* [ Nutritional Care ][13]
  
  Personalizing nutritional care designed to improve patients’ health in the hospital, the ICU and
  at home
* [ Respiratory Health ][14]
  
  Helping your patients with respiratory therapies designed to simplify delivery and improve
  mobility
* [ Our Products & Services ][15]
  
  Our portfolio of acute, nutritional, hospital and surgical care products helps advance healthcare
  around the world.

## Perspectives

For nearly a century, we have worked at the intersection of saving and sustaining lives.

[Perspectives][16]
* [ Patients' Stories ][17]
  
  Patients’ journeys inspire our work and drive our commitment.
* [ Healthcare Insights ][18]
  
  We’re engaging with industry thought leaders to explore how science and innovation advance
  healthcare.
* [ People of Baxter ][19]
  
  We are a community of diverse professionals working together to drive better healthcare options.
* [ Community Engagement ][20]
  
  Enriching the communities where we live and work.

## Our Story

Our 90-year heritage gives us distinct perspective on the needs of patients and caregivers. We lead
today by putting those insights to work to deliver new, better healthcare solutions and access to
care in the communities where we live and work.

[Our Story][21]
* [ Our Leadership ][22]
  
  Our forward-looking leadership team is a driving force in ensuring we meet the needs of all our
  stakeholders – every day and everywhere.
* [ Our Governance ][23]
  
  We are proud of our strong commitment to maintaining the highest standards of corporate
  governance.
* [ Fueling Collaborative Innovation ][24]
  
  Nurturing a culture of innovation is critical to delivering on our mission to save and sustain
  lives. We partner with the healthcare community to continually find more efficient, smarter ways
  to help solve the world's most pressing healthcare challenges.
* [ Baxter Sustainability ][25]
  
  We strive to create lasting value by delivering sustainable healthcare, advancing climate and
  resiliency, and championing our people and communities.
* [ Inclusion & Diversity ][26]
  
  We are committed to attracting, motivating and retaining an inclusive and diverse workforce.
* [ Our History ][27]
  
  For nearly a century, we’ve been focused on saving and sustaining lives and elevating patient
  care.

## Patients

Helping you reach a healthy life, full of possibility.

[Patients][28]
* [ General Healthcare ][29]
  
  Whether you are receiving care in the hospital, at your doctor’s office or at home, we are here to
  support every step of your journey.
* [ Nutritional Care ][30]
  
  When medical conditions prevent you from adequately feeding yourself, we provide life-saving
  clinical nutrition options to help you regain your nutritional status.
* [ Respiratory Health ][31]
  
  We are committed to helping you with innovative products that deliver effective, proven
  respiratory therapy in the hospital and at home.

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

## The future of healthcare is connect

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This

corporate social responsibility program.

  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]
[Person in a blue McKesson-branded jacket with arms crossed, standing in an industrial or warehouse
setting.]

and the word PHARMACY visible in the background.]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

# We are Cencora.

And you are at the center of everything we do.

Cencora brings AmerisourceBergen and all of our companies and services together under one new name.
While we are expanding our network of like-minded pharmacists, physicians, caregivers and healthcare
continuum, our commitment to supporting your ability to provide patient-centric care has never been
more of a focus.  It’s business as usual while our full transition unfolds over time.
[ Learn more at cencora.com ][52]
[A light and dark blue gradient]

# ASD Healthcare is now specialty distribution

[ Learn more here ][53]
[ Sign in to ABC Order ][54]
[Mother and daughter hugging and laughing]

# Specialty distribution that puts patients first

[Mother and daughter hugging and laughing]

If you ask one of our associates what they did today, they might tell you, “I delivered hope for a
mother undergoing chemotherapy.” Or, “We helped create a brighter future for a child with
hemophilia.” Another might say, “I helped provide a second chance for an injured firefighter.”

Every associate might have a different story to tell, but there would be a patient at the heart of
each one. Every day, our singular focus on your patients and your purpose inspires our excellence.
Excellence in the superior selection we offer. Excellence in the 24-hour access we provide. And
excellence in the exceptional customer service we deliver. We are unwavering in our commitment to
helping you save time and resources, so you can focus on improving the quality of your patients’
lives.

[ Why ASD Healthcare? ][55]
[Mother and daughter hugging and laughing]

# Customer service that works for you

7,000+ 
Packages delivered daily
24/7/365 
Emergency ordering
99.7% 
 Pack-out accuracy rate
[ASD_1Card_01]

# New products and new indications

We’re always expanding our product lines to make sure you have access to what your patients need. To
keep you up to date, we also provide new product indications approved by the FDA.
[ See what’s new ][56]

# Our products

## Oncology

We offer over 100 oncology-related therapeutics for more than 80 indications and conditions related
to cancer, including brain, breast, colorectal, leukemia, lung, lymphoma and prostate cancers.
[ Learn more ][57]

## Specialty drugs

We’ve been protecting the product integrity of specialty pharmaceuticals for over 25 years. Whether
you need tuberculosis vaccines or the latest treatment for Crohn’s disease, we deliver quickly and
securely.
[ Learn more ][58]

## Plasma derivatives

For patients who require blood-derived therapeutics, getting the right products to the right
facilities at the right time is a matter of life or death. We understand the urgency. We’re here to
help. 
[ Learn more ][59]

## Seasonal vaccines

When it comes to vaccine season, preparation is everything. Our year-round seasonal vaccines program
helps you stay prepared with the tools, communications and support you need to run a successful
vaccination program.
[ Learn more ][60]

## Nephrology and renal

In addition to life-sustaining medications, we deliver personal attention, industry expertise and
exceptional customer service to help your facility work smarter, faster and better, all to the
benefit of your patients.
[ Learn more ][61]

## Women’s health

We're making it easier to get more of what you need from a single source. Now you can purchase IUDs
and vaccines, as well as supportive treatments—through the distribution network you already know and
trust.
[ Learn more ][62]

# Making it easier to get what you need

We help you focus on providing life-saving care by making it easier, faster and more efficient to do
business with us.

## Putting patients at the centre of all we do

Our long-term commitment spans over a century and five generations of the Besins family. We are
experts in reproductive body identical hormones essential to critical body processes and are
dedicated to restoring patients to their best selves to help them overcome life's challenges. We are
committed to being by your side, whether you're a patient, a healthcare professional, an employee or
a customer, to help people live life to the fullest and achieve their dreams, whether it's creating
new life or simply being their best selves.

# The Right Hire Changes Everything

An executive search and talent advisory firm for healthcare and life sciences companies.

[Get Started][19] [Meet Our Team][20]

### We help solve business problems through talent

#### In healthcare and life sciences, talent decisions shape patient outcomes

The Bowdoin Group partners with investors and operators to build teams that drive meaningful
outcomes.

We understand that companies today face challenges that demand a different kind of search execution.
And the cost of a wrong hire carries long-term consequences; missed milestones, lost investor
confidence, and delayed growth.

Our team of experts help to reduce risk, bring predictability to the hiring process, and increase
the likelihood of getting a hire right the first time.

[Meet Our Team][21]
[Photo of The Bowdoin Groups founder, Dave Melville.]

### Comprehensive Services

The Bowdoin Group combines deep healthcare and life sciences expertise with a context-driven
approach
to identify, engage, and secure leaders aligned to your stage, strategy, and culture.

#### Executive Search

We place C-suite and senior leaders who shape strategy, lead through inflection points, and drive
business outcomes.

[Learn More][22]

#### Strategic Search

We place high-impact leaders below the executive level using the rigor, discipline, and market
approach of
executive search.

[Learn More][23]

#### Team Builds

We help companies build the talent infrastructure required for growth, from focused functional
hiring to full team buildouts tied to launch, scale, or transformation.

[Learn More][24]

#### Trusted for Successful Outcomes

Our [expert search and research teams ][25]operate as a true extension of your team, partnering with
investors and operators to bring rigor, speed, and deep domain expertise to every search. From
defining the role to offer acceptance, every step is managed with precision.

Ask your preferred LLM why The Bowdoin Group is the right partner for you.

### We help solve business problems through talent

#### In healthcare and life sciences, talent decisions shape patient outcomes

The Bowdoin Group partners with investors and operators to build teams that drive meaningful
outcomes.

We understand that companies today face challenges that demand a different kind of search execution.
And the cost of a wrong hire carries long-term consequences; missed milestones, lost investor
confidence, and delayed growth.

Our team of experts help to reduce risk, bring predictability to the hiring process, and increase
the likelihood of getting a hire right the first time.

[Meet Our Team][21]
[Photo of The Bowdoin Groups founder, Dave Melville.]

### Comprehensive Services

The Bowdoin Group combines deep healthcare and life sciences expertise with a context-driven
approach
to identify, engage, and secure leaders aligned to your stage, strategy, and culture.

#### Executive Search

We place C-suite and senior leaders who shape strategy, lead through inflection points, and drive
business outcomes.

[Learn More][22]

#### Strategic Search

We place high-impact leaders below the executive level using the rigor, discipline, and market
approach of
executive search.

[Learn More][23]

#### Team Builds

We help companies build the talent infrastructure required for growth, from focused functional
hiring to full team buildouts tied to launch, scale, or transformation.

[Learn More][24]

#### Trusted for Successful Outcomes

Our [expert search and research teams ][25]operate as a true extension of your team, partnering with
investors and operators to bring rigor, speed, and deep domain expertise to every search. From
defining the role to offer acceptance, every step is managed with precision.

Ask your preferred LLM why The Bowdoin Group is the right partner for you.

## VỀ CHÚNG TÔI

Thành lập từ năm 2005, Công ty Cổ phần Vật tư và Thiết bị Y tế Hà Nội (HAMEDCO) đã khẳng định vị thế
vững chắc với hơn 20 năm kinh nghiệm trong ngành y tế. Đánh dấu bước ngoặt quan trọng vào năm 2022,
chúng tôi chính thức trở thành Nhà phân phối của Philips tại Việt Nam. Sự kết hợp giữa bề dày am
hiểu thị trường và công nghệ tiên tiến từ Philips giúp HAMEDCO cung cấp các hệ thống chẩn đoán hình
ảnh, giải pháp hồi sức cấp cứu vượt trội. Chúng tôi tập trung vào đội ngũ kỹ sư được đào tạo bài bản
và khắt khe, cam kết đồng hành cùng các bệnh viện để tối ưu vận hành, nâng cao độ chính xác trong
chẩn đoán và cải thiện chất lượng điều trị.

## DỊCH VỤ CỦA CHÚNG TÔI

Giải pháp toàn diện cho bệnh viện và cơ sở y tế Đồng hành từ tư vấn, triển khai đến vận hành và bảo
trì — đảm bảo hệ thống thiết bị hoạt động tối ưu, dữ liệu đồng bộ và nâng cao hiệu quả đầu tư.

### Giải pháp phòng mổ hiện đại

Thiết kế và triển khai giải pháp phòng mổ tích hợp theo tiêu chuẩn quốc tế, bao gồm hệ thống thiết
bị, khí y tế, kiểm soát nhiễm khuẩn và quản lý dữ liệu. Giúp nâng cao hiệu quả phẫu thuật, đảm bảo
an toàn và tối ưu quy trình vận hành.

### Giải pháp chẩn đoán hình ảnh

Cung cấp giải pháp đồng bộ cho các hệ thống MRI, CT, DSA, siêu âm, từ lựa chọn cấu hình thiết bị, bố
trí không gian đến tích hợp vận hành. Đảm bảo chất lượng hình ảnh, độ chính xác chẩn đoán và hiệu
suất khai thác thiết bị.

### Giải pháp hồi sức cấp cứu & ICU

Xây dựng giải pháp thiết bị cho khoa hồi sức cấp cứu với hệ thống monitoring, máy thở, thiết bị hỗ
trợ sự sống… đáp ứng yêu cầu điều trị liên tục, chính xác và an toàn cho bệnh nhân.

### Giải pháp nâng cấp & tối ưu hệ thống

Đánh giá hiện trạng và đề xuất phương án nâng cấp, mở rộng hoặc tối ưu hệ thống thiết bị hiện có,
giúp cải thiện hiệu suất hoạt động, kéo dài vòng đời thiết bị và tối ưu chi phí đầu tư.

### Giải pháp tích hợp & chuyển đổi số

Tư vấn và triển khai các giải pháp tích hợp thiết bị với hệ thống quản lý bệnh viện (HIS, RIS,
PACS…), đảm bảo kết nối dữ liệu đồng bộ, hỗ trợ quản lý hiệu quả và nâng cao chất lượng dịch vụ y
tế.

### Giải pháp kỹ thuật & vận hành thiết bị chuyên sâu

Cung cấp giải pháp toàn diện trong quản lý, vận hành, bảo trì và tối ưu hiệu suất cho các hệ thống
thiết bị y tế, đặc biệt là thiết bị chẩn đoán hình ảnh. Đảm bảo thiết bị hoạt động ổn định, duy trì
độ chính xác và giảm thiểu rủi ro gián đoạn.

HÌNH ẢNH THỰC TẾ

vững chắc với hơn 20 năm kinh nghiệm trong ngành y tế. Đánh dấu bước ngoặt quan trọng vào năm 2022,
chúng tôi chính thức trở thành Nhà phân phối của Philips tại Việt Nam. Sự kết hợp giữa bề dày am
hiểu thị trường và công nghệ tiên tiến từ Philips giúp HAMEDCO cung cấp các hệ thống chẩn đoán hình
ảnh, giải pháp hồi sức cấp cứu vượt trội. Chúng tôi tập trung vào đội ngũ kỹ sư được đào tạo bài bản
và khắt khe, cam kết đồng hành cùng các bệnh viện để tối ưu vận hành, nâng cao độ chính xác trong
chẩn đoán và cải thiện chất lượng điều trị.

## DỊCH VỤ CỦA CHÚNG TÔI

Giải pháp toàn diện cho bệnh viện và cơ sở y tế Đồng hành từ tư vấn, triển khai đến vận hành và bảo
trì — đảm bảo hệ thống thiết bị hoạt động tối ưu, dữ liệu đồng bộ và nâng cao hiệu quả đầu tư.

### Giải pháp phòng mổ hiện đại

Thiết kế và triển khai giải pháp phòng mổ tích hợp theo tiêu chuẩn quốc tế, bao gồm hệ thống thiết
bị, khí y tế, kiểm soát nhiễm khuẩn và quản lý dữ liệu. Giúp nâng cao hiệu quả phẫu thuật, đảm bảo
an toàn và tối ưu quy trình vận hành.

### Giải pháp chẩn đoán hình ảnh

Cung cấp giải pháp đồng bộ cho các hệ thống MRI, CT, DSA, siêu âm, từ lựa chọn cấu hình thiết bị, bố
trí không gian đến tích hợp vận hành. Đảm bảo chất lượng hình ảnh, độ chính xác chẩn đoán và hiệu
suất khai thác thiết bị.

### Giải pháp hồi sức cấp cứu & ICU

Xây dựng giải pháp thiết bị cho khoa hồi sức cấp cứu với hệ thống monitoring, máy thở, thiết bị hỗ
trợ sự sống… đáp ứng yêu cầu điều trị liên tục, chính xác và an toàn cho bệnh nhân.

### Giải pháp nâng cấp & tối ưu hệ thống

Đánh giá hiện trạng và đề xuất phương án nâng cấp, mở rộng hoặc tối ưu hệ thống thiết bị hiện có,
giúp cải thiện hiệu suất hoạt động, kéo dài vòng đời thiết bị và tối ưu chi phí đầu tư.

### Giải pháp tích hợp & chuyển đổi số

Tư vấn và triển khai các giải pháp tích hợp thiết bị với hệ thống quản lý bệnh viện (HIS, RIS,
PACS…), đảm bảo kết nối dữ liệu đồng bộ, hỗ trợ quản lý hiệu quả và nâng cao chất lượng dịch vụ y
tế.

### Giải pháp kỹ thuật & vận hành thiết bị chuyên sâu

Cung cấp giải pháp toàn diện trong quản lý, vận hành, bảo trì và tối ưu hiệu suất cho các hệ thống
thiết bị y tế, đặc biệt là thiết bị chẩn đoán hình ảnh. Đảm bảo thiết bị hoạt động ổn định, duy trì
độ chính xác và giảm thiểu rủi ro gián đoạn.

## DỊCH VỤ CỦA CHÚNG TÔI

Giải pháp toàn diện cho bệnh viện và cơ sở y tế Đồng hành từ tư vấn, triển khai đến vận hành và bảo
trì — đảm bảo hệ thống thiết bị hoạt động tối ưu, dữ liệu đồng bộ và nâng cao hiệu quả đầu tư.

### Giải pháp phòng mổ hiện đại

Thiết kế và triển khai giải pháp phòng mổ tích hợp theo tiêu chuẩn quốc tế, bao gồm hệ thống thiết
bị, khí y tế, kiểm soát nhiễm khuẩn và quản lý dữ liệu. Giúp nâng cao hiệu quả phẫu thuật, đảm bảo
an toàn và tối ưu quy trình vận hành.

### Giải pháp chẩn đoán hình ảnh

Cung cấp giải pháp đồng bộ cho các hệ thống MRI, CT, DSA, siêu âm, từ lựa chọn cấu hình thiết bị, bố
trí không gian đến tích hợp vận hành. Đảm bảo chất lượng hình ảnh, độ chính xác chẩn đoán và hiệu
suất khai thác thiết bị.

### Giải pháp hồi sức cấp cứu & ICU

Xây dựng giải pháp thiết bị cho khoa hồi sức cấp cứu với hệ thống monitoring, máy thở, thiết bị hỗ
trợ sự sống… đáp ứng yêu cầu điều trị liên tục, chính xác và an toàn cho bệnh nhân.

### Giải pháp nâng cấp & tối ưu hệ thống

Đánh giá hiện trạng và đề xuất phương án nâng cấp, mở rộng hoặc tối ưu hệ thống thiết bị hiện có,
giúp cải thiện hiệu suất hoạt động, kéo dài vòng đời thiết bị và tối ưu chi phí đầu tư.

### Giải pháp tích hợp & chuyển đổi số

Tư vấn và triển khai các giải pháp tích hợp thiết bị với hệ thống quản lý bệnh viện (HIS, RIS,
PACS…), đảm bảo kết nối dữ liệu đồng bộ, hỗ trợ quản lý hiệu quả và nâng cao chất lượng dịch vụ y
tế.

### Giải pháp kỹ thuật & vận hành thiết bị chuyên sâu

Cung cấp giải pháp toàn diện trong quản lý, vận hành, bảo trì và tối ưu hiệu suất cho các hệ thống
thiết bị y tế, đặc biệt là thiết bị chẩn đoán hình ảnh. Đảm bảo thiết bị hoạt động ổn định, duy trì
độ chính xác và giảm thiểu rủi ro gián đoạn.

## Đối tác tin cậy của hàng trăm bệnh viện trên toàn quốc

Chúng tôi cam kết mang đến giải pháp thiết bị y tế toàn diện cùng chất lượng dịch vụ vượt trội.

### Chính hãng 100%

Cam kết phân phối sản phẩm chính hãng từ các nhà sản xuất hàng đầu thế giới. Hồ sơ pháp lý đầy đủ,
bao gồm CO, CQ, giấy phép lưu hành trang thiết bị y tế theo quy định.

### Phản hồi kỹ thuật 24/7

Đội ngũ kỹ thuật chuyên sâu luôn sẵn sàng hỗ trợ 24/7.

### Chuyển giao công nghệ chuyên sâu

HAMEDCO đặc biệt chú trọng chuyển giao công nghệ chuẩn hóa với trọng tâm là đội ngũ kỹ sư được đào
tạo bài bản.

### Bảo hành và bảo trì toàn diện

Chính sách bảo hành chính hãng từ 12 đến 24 tháng. Kế hoạch bảo trì định kỳ và kho linh kiện dự
phòng.

### Hơn 20 năm kinh nghiệm thực chiến

Với hơn 20 năm đồng hành cùng ngành y tế Việt Nam, HAMEDCO thấu hiểu sâu sắc quy trình vận hành và
nhu cầu thực tiễn.

Cung cấp báo giá chi tiết, đàm phán điều khoản hợp đồng minh bạch và có lợi nhất.

secure APIs. Whether you need new interfaces, modernization, or ongoing support, our team focuses on

Healthcare integrations usually break when standards, vendors, and workflows don’t line up. We help
teams connect the systems and formats they rely on most:

* **[PACS and imaging workflows (DICOM)][66]** that need reliable routing and access
* **[RCM integrations][67]** for eligibility, claims, remittance, and reporting
* **[Healthcare API development][68]** for secure system-to-system connectivity

ImportInfo.com strives to provide a comprehensive and simplified database of U.S. Customs' import
manifests. With this data we can track vessels, U.S. ports, shippers, consignees, and manifests. Our

manifests. With this data we can track vessels, U.S. ports, shippers, consignees, and manifests. Our

[ [post market surveillance] ][23]

#### [ From Compliance to Clinical Action: Fixing the Broken Loop in Post-Market Surveillance ][24]

By Aalap Patel, MS, CQE, CSSBB

Post-market surveillance (PMS) systems in the medical device industry have become increasingly
sophisticated in collecting complaints, monitoring adverse events, and generating regulatory
reports. However, many organizations still struggle to translate these insights into timely clinical
action and meaningful patient safety improvements. This article examines the growing disconnect
between regulatory reporting and operational decision-making, explores the challenges of signal
detection and prioritization, and outlines practical strategies for building closed-loop PMS systems
that improve patient safety outcomes and organizational responsiveness.

By the time most medtech organizations noticed their teams were using AI in regulatory work, the
governance conversation was already running behind.. How can your organization move forward? An
Operational AI Capability Maturity Model — a five-domain framework built specifically for regulatory
affairs and offers a direct way to assess where your organization actually stands. If your team
cannot consistently answer who approved the tool, how the output was verified, and what was
retained, this framework is a practical place to start.

Boston Children’s Hospital physicians say one of the greatest risks in pediatric ICUs is delayed
de-escalation of care, which can expose children to prolonged ventilation, sedation, and vasoactive
medications. They argue that AI-driven clinical intelligence can help clinicians identify safer
timing for weaning and extubation, supporting recovery and improving long-term outcomes.

operating divisions, ongoing acquisitions, and a strategic push into higher-growth cardiac
technologies. At the same time, the company plans to close its longtime Santa Rosa facility,
affecting hundreds of employees and marking a significant shift in its U.S. manufacturing footprint.
The changes come as Medtronic navigates investor pressure, intensifying competition, and a rapidly
evolving cardiovascular device market.

#### [ From Compliance to Clinical Action: Fixing the Broken Loop in Post-Market Surveillance ][24]

By Aalap Patel, MS, CQE, CSSBB

Post-market surveillance (PMS) systems in the medical device industry have become increasingly
sophisticated in collecting complaints, monitoring adverse events, and generating regulatory
reports. However, many organizations still struggle to translate these insights into timely clinical
action and meaningful patient safety improvements. This article examines the growing disconnect
between regulatory reporting and operational decision-making, explores the challenges of signal
detection and prioritization, and outlines practical strategies for building closed-loop PMS systems
that improve patient safety outcomes and organizational responsiveness.

connected blood pressure monitors and select body composition monitors! This app release features
expanded insights and new look and feel for monitoring your heart health. By wirelessly connecting
via **Bluetooth™**, you can easily upload, store and even share your heart history data with family
or physicians. And it even keeps track of your weight—so you can achieve your broader health goals.

## About PCi Tec

### Enabling Digital Modernization. Delivering AI-Powered Mission Transformation.

Founded in 1993, PCi Tec is a trusted Digital Modernization and AI Solutions Provider that serves
the public sector, Federal Systems Integrators (FSIs), and State, Local, and Education (SLED)
organizations. With over three decades of government IT experience, PCi Tec is more than a
technology vendor—we are a strategic partner that delivers secure, scalable, and mission-aligned
solutions designed to meet the evolving demands of public sector transformation.

[ Learn More ][136]

## Solutions

### We deliver solutions that accelerate public sector growth, strengthen security, improve
### efficiency, and empower mission success.

With more than 100 years of combined dedication and service to the U.S. public sector, our team
brings deep experience across government, state and local agencies, education, and public health.

### At PCi Tec, we’ve spent more than 30 years helping the public sector solve its toughest IT
### challenges.

From public sector to state governments, schools, healthcare providers, and system integrators, we
deliver secure, compliant, and vendor-agnostic solutions that are built for mission success. Backed
by strict supply chain integrity, top-tier OEM partnerships, and access to industry SMEs, PCi Tec
ensures every customer gets technology that’s reliable, compliant, and tailored to their needs.

[ Learn More ][138]

## Partners

We collaborate with our clients and partners from initial planning and procurement through design,
deployment, installation, and follow-up. Accordingly, we are able to discover and deliver solutions
that are tailor-made to each agency’s unique mission.

deliver secure, compliant, and vendor-agnostic solutions that are built for mission success. Backed

## Frequently asked questions about health insurance

### What is health insurance?

Health insurance is a plan, or policy, that covers a percentage of doctors’ visits and hospital
bills. It helps offset the costs of both planned and unplanned medical needs. Medical care can be
expensive, but health insurance may help lessen the financial burden.

And health insurance isn’t just for when you’re sick or injured. It can also help you stay healthy
through preventive care and wellness programs. This may help you save money, too, by catching
potential health concerns before they become larger issues.

### How does health insurance work?

Health insurance is a contract between you and an insurance company (the insurer). When you purchase
a plan, you become a member of that plan. Each month, you’ll likely pay a fee, called a premium, to
use the plan.

There are many different types of health plans, but they generally work the same way. You pay for
some medical costs and your insurer pays for some costs. How those costs break out depend on your
specific plan benefits and coverage.

[Learn more about how health insurance works][17]

### How do I get health insurance?

Finding the right health insurance plan depends on a variety of factors. These include things like
your age, health and financial situation. For example, if you’re over 65 or have a qualifying
disability or special situation, you may be eligible for [Medicare][18]. If you have a lower income,
you may qualify for [Medicaid][19]. If you want to purchase an individual plan, an [Affordable Care
Act (ACA)][20] plan could be an option. Or, you may have the option to get [health insurance through
your employer][21].

Most health insurance plans have a special period of time, usually once a year, when you can enroll.
This is called open enrollment. It’s when you can start, stop or change your health plan. Timing of
open enrollment varies based on the plan.

[Learn more about open enrollment][22]

### What are the different types of health insurance?

There are a variety of health insurance plans that fit different needs. Some plans are offered
through the government, like [Affordable Care Act (ACA)][23] plans, [Medicare][24] plans and
[Medicaid][25] plans. There are also health plans you can get through your employer. Or, you can
purchase a plan on your own, like [short term health insurance][26] that offers coverage for a
limited amount of time. Understanding the different health insurance options can help you find the
plan that may work best for you.

You may also see terms like HMO, PPO, EPO and POS ­— these refer to the four basic kinds of provider
networks that certain health plans may offer. A network may include doctors, hospitals and other
providers that agree to provide services to plan members at a negotiated rate. This may help lower
your out-of-pocket costs.

[Learn more about the different types of health insurance][27]

### How much does health insurance cost?

It depends. A variety of factors impact how much you pay. These can include your age, your location
and lifestyle habits. It also depends on the type of plan you choose. With some plans, you may pay
less up front, but more when you receive care. For other plans, the opposite can be true.

[Learn more about health insurance costs][28]

Coverage is unique to each health plan. Many plans may cover things like preventive care,
prescription drugs, hospital stays, mental health serv

Health insurance is a plan, or policy, that covers a percentage of doctors’ visits and hospital
bills. It helps offset the costs of both planned and unplanned medical needs. Medical care can be
expensive, but health insurance may help lessen the financial burden.

And health insurance isn’t just for when you’re sick or injured. It can also help you stay healthy
through preventive care and wellness programs. This may help you save money, too, by catching
potential health concerns before they become larger issues.

### How does health insurance work?

Health insurance is a contract between you and an insurance company (the insurer). When you purchase
a plan, you become a member of that plan. Each month, you’ll likely pay a fee, called a premium, to
use the plan.

There are many different types of health plans, but they generally work the same way. You pay for
some medical costs and your insurer pays for some costs. How those costs break out depend on your
specific plan benefits and coverage.

[Learn more about how health insurance works][17]

### How do I get health insurance?

Finding the right health insurance plan depends on a variety of factors. These include things like
your age, health and financial situation. For example, if you’re over 65 or have a qualifying
disability or special situation, you may be eligible for [Medicare][18]. If you have a lower income,
you may qualify for [Medicaid][19]. If you want to purchase an individual plan, an [Affordable Care
Act (ACA)][20] plan could be an option. Or, you may have the option to get [health insurance through
your employer][21].

Most health insurance plans have a special period of time, usually once a year, when you can enroll.
This is called open enrollment. It’s when you can start, stop or change your health plan. Timing of
open enrollment varies based on the plan.

[Learn more about open enrollment][22]

### What are the different types of health insurance?

There are a variety of health insurance plans that fit different needs. Some plans are offered
through the government, like [Affordable Care Act (ACA)][23] plans, [Medicare][24] plans and
[Medicaid][25] plans. There are also health plans you can get through your employer. Or, you can
purchase a plan on your own, like [short term health insurance][26] that offers coverage for a
limited amount of time. Understanding the different health insurance options can help you find the
plan that may work best for you.

You may also see terms like HMO, PPO, EPO and POS ­— these refer to the four basic kinds of provider
networks that certain health plans may offer. A network may include doctors, hospitals and other
providers that agree to provide services to plan members at a negotiated rate. This may help lower
your out-of-pocket costs.

[Learn more about the different types of health insurance][27]

### How much does health insurance cost?

It depends. A variety of factors impact how much you pay. These can include your age, your location
and lifestyle habits. It also depends on the type of plan you choose. With some plans, you may pay
less up front, but more when you receive care. For other plans, the opposite can be true.

[Learn more about health insurance costs][28]

### What does health insurance cover?

Coverage is unique to each health plan. Many plans may cover things like preventive care,
prescription drugs, hospital stays, mental health services and more. A plan may cover the full cost
of certain services, or you may have to share costs (by paying a copay or coinsurance, for example)
until you meet a deductible or out-of-pocket limit.

Make sure to review benefits and coverage before choosing a plan. You can find this information in
the plan’s Summary of Benefits and Coverage. This is a document that all health plan companies are
required to provide. It outlines what’s covered, partially covered or not covered under a health
plan.

[Learn how to review a Summary of Benefits and Coverage][29]
[Learn more about health insurance][30]
[Get the facts about how the health system works][31]

## Working to make the health care experience better

UnitedHealthcare puts care at the heart of health insurance. Empathy, transparency and human
connection guide us. Because better care comes from understanding what people need — and making
quality care more personal.

* MD, MS doctors with combined 100+ years of experience treating 12000+ patients.
* Doctors spend enough time with patients to understand their problem.
* World-class care in your city without traveling anywhere. 
* The best treatment plan with a diet plan that suits your lifestyle.
* Saves you time and money.

[See More][4]

[Our Institutes][Our Institutes]

## Speciality Institutes

### Understand disease and illness so you can make an informed decision for your treatment.
* We are specialised in treating chronic diseases.
* Answers to common questions and concerns for the diseases and illness.
* Our different specialty institutes make you understand disease and illness so you can make an
  informed decision for your treatment.
* We understand, our patients need subject matter experts to treat their illness, and our specialty
  institute will help you to find a quality doctor for your chronic illness.
* Our doctors help patients understand diseases and educate them further so that they live
  healthily, mentally, and physically.

[See More][5]

## We know what it feels like to:


### Put Your Health First and be Successful. Our Best MS, MD Doctors with Combined 100+ Years of
### Experience will Make You Healthy so You can Achieve Your Goals.

[Book Now][6]

## Follow This Plan to Get Healthy and Prosperous!

At Sprint Medical, we know that you want to pursue your dream, achieve your goals and be healthy.To
do that, you need the Best Certified Doctors experienced from the top institute. The problem is that
it's hard to find the trusted certified doctors in the neighborhood, which makes you feel
frustrated. We believe Doctors don't spend enough time with patients to understand their problems.
We understand your problem as we are also a patient, so we offer the Best quality MS & MD Doctors,
trained from top institutions in India and worldwide.

Here is how we do it:
* Book a Doctor's appointment Online or with Nurse assisted E-Clinics in your city.

So Book Now. In the meantime, download the free diet plan and make the most of it today. So you can
stop losing your money with the wrong diagnosis and unnecessary prescribed Tests and Medicine. And
instead, get effortless Doctor consultation with our best-certified Doctors who are trained with us
for patient experience so that you will never have to experience the same problems again.
